evidence_boundary: No policy calls, native scenes, measured failures, trajectories, or renderer checks. Object IDs are evaluator-only labels, never policy input.

common_contract.scope: Terminal object membership only; physical release/stability and deadline must be specified in a later native protocol.
common_contract.assumed_visibility: All objects and tray contents intended visible; no images/poses instantiated, so visibility and reachability unverified.
common_contract.target_definition: P={o in finite scene inventory U: all filter attributes match}
common_contract.all_validity: Final tray member set S equals P
common_contract.exactly_validity: S is a subset of P and |S|=k
common_contract.cardinality_feasibility: EXACTLY requires 0<=k<=|P|; infeasible requests are outside these eight cases
common_contract.extra_objects: No member of U\P may be in tray; scene inventory assumed complete
common_contract.path_constraints: None; moving an object and restoring it is not forbidden by these final-state instructions
common_contract.minimum_change_unit: Minimum |initial_tray symmetric_difference S| over valid S; abstract membership changes, not actions, ticks, time or reachable physical cost
common_contract.free_choice_fairness: Do not force one valid subset as the only ground truth. An enumerating baseline commits to a subset; its choice changes physical difficulty and is not automatically a matched language-only comparison.
common_contract.native_task_status: ADAPTATION_REQUIRED; these cases are not runnable upstream configurations
